consequence.statement: If the NameConstraints feature gate is not set explicitly, the CA NameConstraints feature is now on by default after the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Check whether the CA NameConstraints feature should be on. If not, set NameConstraints=false explicitly in the feature gates.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0 the CA NameConstraints feature gate is promoted to Beta and is now enabled by default.
